run_benchmark_regression_check: run the benchmark regression check to detect performance regressions in habitat-lab
check_benchmark_sps_function: check benchmark steps per second against minimum performance thresholds for a given base name
create_regression_error: create a custom RegressionError exception to signal benchmark performance regression failures
review_check_benchmark_sps: review the check_benchmark_sps function that parses FPS from profile files and compares to thresholds
summarize_benchmark_thresholds: summarize the minimum performance thresholds for 1-process and 16-process benchmark configurations
